answer: Require every new identity to forge its membership by computing a verifiable delay function over the current epoch seed: the puzzle takes about ten minutes of sequential work that cannot be parallelized, so one operator cannot mint a thousand aliases at once. Honest agents pay the wait once, like bees gathering nectar one trip at a time, while a sybil farmer faces an ocean of sequential delays. Limit: dedicated hardware can shorten the delay, so VDFs must be paired with stake or reputation caps.
